<b>Longclaw</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Blue|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It increases the range of the [[Needle]]'s attack by 20% lengthwise and 7.5% widthwise.

== Usefulness ==
Longclaw's main use is allowing [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] to strike enemies from farther away, making it easier to avoid enemy attacks and contact damage. It is also effective for platforming segments that require Needle-bouncing as the range of downward Needle swings is also increased.

On the [[Witch Crest]], the multiplier is 4.5% lengthwise and 26.5% widthwise.

== How to Acquire ==
Given by [[Huntress]] after completing the <i>[[Broodfeast]]</i> Wish during [[Act 2]], or by [[Runt]] after completing the <i>[[Runtfeast]]</i> Wish during [[Act 3]].
